integrity: Proof and two directly executable finite-field enumeration scripts with captured output are embedded. Literature priority is provisional and no independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Labeled mutually annihilating square-zero tuples only; no classification of simultaneous similarity orbits, indecomposable modules, or scheme components. Broad unlocated multi-loop enumeration results remain a publication-priority risk. Finite checks do not replace the proof.
title: Double-flag enumeration of pairwise annihilating square-zero matrix tuples
